events.name: Detroit Red Wings at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Failing to score until there were 32 seconds left and allowing a hat trick to Gabriel Perreault, the Detroit Red Wings lost an important game in their pursuit of a playoff spot, 4-1 at the New York Rangers on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Red Wings' playoff pursuit takes a hit with a 4-1 loss to the already-eliminated Rangers

headlines.description: — Ryan Hartman scored twice to lead the Minnesota Wild to a 4-1 win over the Ottawa Senators on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hartman scores twice to lead the Wild to a 4-1 win over the Senators

headlines.description: — Martin Necas broke a scoreless tie midway through the third period, Nathan MacKinnon added an empty-netter and the NHL-leading Colorado Avalanche took a big step toward home-ice advantage throughout the playoffs with a 2-0 victory over the Dallas...
headlines.shortLinkText: NHL-leading Avs blank Stars 2-0 for big step toward home-ice advantage throughout playoffs

events.name: Boston Bruins at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Darren Raddysh broke a tie with 5:31 left and Tampa Bay beat the Boston Bruins 3-1 on Saturday night, hours after the Lightning secured a playoff spot.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lightning beat the Bruins 3-1 hours after securing a playoff spot

headlines.description: — Evgeni Malkin had his 14th career hat trick and added an assist to become the 23rd player in NHL history to reach 1,400 career points, and the Pittsburgh Penguins routed the Florida Panthers 9-4 on Saturday to eliminate the two-time defending...
headlines.shortLinkText: Malkin has 14th career hat trick, Penguins rout Panthers 9-4 to end Florida's bid for a 3-peat

events.name: Montreal Canadiens at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Oliver Kapanen's decisive goal in the shootout gave the Montreal Canadiens a 4-3 win over the New Jersey Devils for their eighth straight win on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kapanen's shootout goal gives Canadiens a 4-3 win over Devils for their 8th straight

headlines.description: — Aliaksei Protas had a goal and assist in his return from injury and the Washington Capitals beat the Buffalo Sabres 6-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Protas scores in return from injury as Capitals keep playoff hopes alive with 6-2 win over Sabres

events.name: New York Islanders at Carolina Hurricanes

headlines.description: — Seth Jarvis had two goals and an assist and the Carolina Hurricanes beat the New York Islanders 4-3 on Saturday night for their fourth victory in five games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jarvis scores twice to help the Hurricanes beat the Islanders 4-3

events.name: Winnipeg Jets at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Kyle Connor scored twice and the Winnipeg Jets overcame an early deficit to beat the Columbus 2-1 on Saturday night, keeping their playoff hopes alive and sending the Blue Jackets to their sixth straight loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor scores twice as the Jets beat the Blue Jackets 2-1 to stay in the playoff hunt

headlines.description: — Clayton Keller had the third hat trick of his career and the Utah Mammoth extended their winning streak to three games with a 7-4 victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Clayton Keller's 3rd career hat trick helps Mammoth to a 7-4 win over the Canucks

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Quinton Byfield scored 2:33 into overtime, Adrian Kempe had two goals and two assists, and the Los Angeles Kings beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 7-6 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Quinton Byfield scores in OT to boost Kings' playoff hopes with a 7-6 win over Maple Leafs

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Edmonton Oilers

headlines.description: — Carter Hart made 31 saves and the Vegas Golden Knights tightened the Pacific Division race, beating the Edmonton Oilers 5-1 on Saturday night to remain perfect in John Tortorella's first three games as coach.
headlines.shortLinkText: Golden Knights beat Oilers 5-1 to tighten Pacific Division race

headlines.description: — Ryan Strome scored his 500th career point with a goal against his former team, Morgan Frost had two goals and the Calgary Flames sent the Anaheim Ducks to their fifth consecutive loss with a 5-3...
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan Strome scores against former team, Ducks' late-season skid extends to 5 with 5-3 loss to Flames

events.name: Nashville Predators at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Ryan O'Reilly broke a tie midway through the third period and the Nashville Predators beat the San Jose Sharks 6-3 on Saturday night in a key game in the playoff race.
headlines.shortLinkText: Predators beat the Sharks for the 15th straight time with a 6-3 victory

headlines.description: — Sacha Boisvert scored his first NHL goal with 5:42 to play to give Chicago a two-goal lead and Tyler Bertuzzi scored his team-leading 32nd goal as the Blackhawks beat the Seattle Kraken 4-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Boisvert scores first NHL goal as the Blackhawks beat the Kraken 4-2
